origin: Copied selected fixtures from ha-birdbuddy commit a2c4dce. Synthetic fixtures are not observed account responses.

feed_variants.json.purpose: Nested collection.species, singular/plural media, explicit collection feeder attribution, mystery/null and new/collected variants.

public_postcard_analysis.json.purpose: Modern analysis result with five images, one video and recognized preview species. Structure and media cardinality retained.

public_collected_partial.json.purpose: Deliberately partial public collected result: eleven assets have IDs/types only. Tests must not assume content URLs or timestamps are present.

postcard_complete.json.purpose: Full selected-shape card with explicit feeder, two images and video; use for event/share/media preservation.

postcard_video_only.json.purpose: Video-only card: future normalizer and events must not silently drop the sole asset.

postcard_unrecognized.json.purpose: A HIGH_CONFIDENCE card can have no recognized species; inference flag is not evidence of a bird.

postcard_long_urls.json.purpose: Large but schema-valid mixed-media card above32KiB; padding is harmless placeholder text, not an actual signature.

feed_unknown_type.json.purpose: Invented future union member; intentionally outside current schema to test graceful unknown-type handling.

feed_malformed_timestamp.json.purpose: Selected non-null createdAt is intentionally null to exercise backend/schema-drift tolerance.
